identity.name: VolleyPro
identity.description: A high-contrast, mobile-critical tournament manager that feels like professional sports equipment. Not a spreadsheet, but a cockpit for the beach.

usage_rules.headings: Uppercase, tracking-tight, font-weight 700 or 900. Use for all section titles and scores.
usage_rules.body: High legibility, standard tracking. Use for player names and rules.
usage_rules.labels: Uppercase, tracking-widest, text-xs, font-weight 600. Use for 'SET 1', 'COURT 2'.

primary.description: Sunset Orange - High visibility action color

secondary.description: Deep Turquoise - Ocean vibes, used for headers and active states

background.description: Sand White - Reduces glare, warm tone

card.description: Pure White - Pops against sand background

text.description: Deep Navy - Softer than black, nautical contrast

accent.description: Sun Yellow - For winners and highlights

spacing_system.base: Generous padding (p-4 to p-8) for touch targets.
spacing_system.mobile_rule: Minimum 44px touch targets for ALL interactive elements.
spacing_system.containers: Use 'container mx-auto px-4 max-w-md' for mobile-first views.

grid_strategy.dashboard: Bento Grid (Grid cols 1 on mobile, cols 3 on desktop).
grid_strategy.lists: Cardless or subtle border-bottom lists for density on mobile.

buttons.secondary: bg-white border-2 border-ocean/20 text-ocean hover:border-ocean hover:bg-ocean/5

inputs.style: bg-stone-50 border-stone-200 focus:border-ocean focus:ring-ocean/20 rounded-lg h-12 text-lg

bracket.instruction: Do NOT build a giant pan-zoom canvas. Build a 'Round View' where users swipe left/right to see different rounds (e.g., Quarter Finals -> Semi Finals).

score_input.instruction: Massive +/- buttons. Full screen modal. Vibration feedback on tap if possible.

textures.noise: Use a subtle noise texture on the background to simulate sand grain (opacity 0.03).

shadows.sharp: shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] (Use only for 'Brutalist' mode if requested, otherwise stick to soft)

icons.style: Stroke width 2px. Color: Ocean or Navy.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text is Navy (hsl(222, 47%, 11%)) on Sand/White backgrounds. Sunset Orange is for buttons, not text.
accessibility.touch_targets: Min 44x44px. Add p-4 to small icons.

instructions_to_main_agent.general: You are building a mobile-critical app. Always check how it looks on a 375px width. Use 'hidden md:block' for desktop-only decorations.
instructions_to_main_agent.auth: Simple, clean forms. Use the sand texture background.
instructions_to_main_agent.dashboard: Show 'Active Tournaments' first. Big 'Create Tournament' FAB (Floating Action Button) or bottom bar.
instructions_to_main_agent.tournament_view: Tabs: Standings | Matches | Bracket. Default to Matches for active tournaments.
instructions_to_main_agent.score_entry: This is the most critical screen. It must be foolproof. Big numbers. Clear 'Finish Match' button.
instructions_to_main_agent.export: Use a simple PDF generation library. Keep the PDF design clean and high-contrast (black/white) for printing.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯📚🎭🎬🎪🎉🎊🎁🎀🎂🍰🎈🎨🎰💰💵💳🏦💎🪙💸🤑📊📈📉💹🔢🏆🥇 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...)
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...})
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx
